arc.album_arc_notes: Opening triptych (01-03) is the only vocal stretch: voice asks questions, repeats refrains, then leaves at 8:17 of track 03 and never returns. Middle (04-08) is the laboratory: one signature device per track. Track 09 (GHOST RIOTS, 184.6 BPM) is the speed peak and the only soft ending. Tracks 10-11 are the slow turn (minor-to-major flip; slowest tempo 107.7). Closing pair (13-14) is a tempo handoff: ZERO DAY steps to 143.6 BPM, ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS takes that tempo and closes on a 95 s sub-bass coda. Album ends on F where it began, but at maximum volume in the dark instead of at a diagnosis.
arc.energy_shape_notes: Every track ends louder than it opens (opening-to-closing deltas +5.2 to +40.4 dB). No fades anywhere; 13 of 14 tracks end with a hard stop at volume, GHOST RIOTS alone dims out. The valley-before-the-climax is the album's core form: deepest quiet passage immediately before the loudest arrival (GEOMETRY OF BELIEF, ZERO DAY, DECEPTIVE PERCEPTIONS, ANGER MANAGEMENT, TIMETABLE). Track forms: two rise-peak-annihilation arches (ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS), staircases (TIMETABLE), plateaus with one climb (ZERO DAY, OFFLINE), single unbroken body (GHOST RIOTS). Sections per track: 5-12.

generator_hints.drums: four-on-the-floor feel assumed from ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS deep passes; UNVERIFIED for tracks 01-13 (no onset/drum data in their features) - treat as prescription, not measured fact
generator_hints.structure_rule: Place the deepest quiet passage immediately before the loudest arrival. End louder than the track started, hard stop, no fade, no decrescendo.
generator_hints.tempo_rule: Default 143.6 BPM; 136 BPM as second gear. Move tempo by STEPS at section boundaries, not ramps. Arches (faster-slower-faster) allowed.
generator_hints.timbre_rule: Bright valleys, dark endings: centroid falls as level peaks. Darkness marks structural turns (valley entries, finales).
generator_hints.vocal_rule: Vocals appear only in the opening sequence (tracks 01-03 of 14) and then leave. If a new track has vocals, place it early in a sequence or treat it as a distinct voice against an instrumental set. Never generate lyrics from transcripts of tracks 04-14 - they are hallucinated.

harmony.home_scale: F natural minor (F G Ab Bb C Db Eb) is the album home; Eb minor opens the album (01, 02, 07); Db/C# is the second home (03, 04, 11, 14); G# minor carries the middle (08, 09, 10); D minor is the TIMETABLE outlier. Key-window counts across the album: F min 67, G# min 38, C# maj 35, D# min 28, C# min 26, D min 24. Flat-side minor only; no sharp-side keys except D min and an E-min stretch in DECEPTIVE PERCEPTIONS.
signature_devices: Third-toggle vamp: static root, alternate major/minor 3rd (ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS Db ~13 s cycle; MONASTERY C# every 30 s for 5 min; DIAGNOSTIC OVERLOAD Eb opening; ZERO DAY as simultaneous mixture). Tension via third-ambiguity, not functional motion.
Whole-step and semitone root moves: DIAGNOSTIC OVERLOAD Eb->F; DIGITAL HOUSE OF CARDS Eb->C#; LYRICAL DOOM F->Eb->F; USER & MACHINE semitone slip Eb->D across a valley.
Flat-side key migration by smuggled centers: ZERO DAY F->Bb->C, each new root already a top-3 chroma pitch before it becomes the center.

One-collection tonicization drift: GEOMETRY OF BELIEF holds Db major / F natural minor for 12:23 and moves the tonic Db->F min->Ab maj; GHOST RIOTS rotates G# min / E maj / B maj (same seven notes); DECEPTIVE PERCEPTIONS oscillates E min <-> G maj. Naive key detectors report these as modulations; they are relabelings of one collection.
Harmonic narrowing to a pedal: TIMETABLE strips a full D-minor set to chroma D = 1.00 by the end; ZERO DAY narrows the same way. The progression is a subtraction.
No cadences anywhere on the album: no V-i, no functioning leading tones, no secondary dominants in any of the 14 tracks. Never resolve.

rhythm.drum_pattern: four-on-the-floor feel (ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS deep passes: hardgroove, no backbeat on 2-and-4, straight offbeat-16th hats, no swing, 3:2 polyrhythm in peaks only). UNVERIFIED for tracks 01-13 - no onset data in their features.
signature_devices: Grid-locked throughout: downbeat spacing constant within each track (allowing for tempo steps). Pulse never dissolves except ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS' breakdown (arrhythmic, not half-time).
Tempo steps at section boundaries: TIMETABLE 136->143.6 at 3:00; ZERO DAY 136->143.6 at 8:00 (143.6 is ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS' tempo - the handoff is built into the number).
Tempo arches: DECEPTIVE PERCEPTIONS 143.6->129.2->143.6; ANGER MANAGEMENT ~144->~152->~140; GHOST RIOTS ~179->~192->~173; LYRICAL DOOM stepped accelerando 103->129->136.

Valley-then-louder: deepest sustained valley immediately precedes the final climb (ZERO DAY 7:25-8:00 -> loudest ending); hole before the slam (GEOMETRY OF BELIEF -19.8 dB at 11:40 -> -9.3 dB at 11:45); cliff inside the finale (TIMETABLE -2.4 dB at 7:20 -> -21.9 dB at 7:35 -> climb back).
12+ hard cuts 0.2-0.5 s in ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS; deepest silences placed immediately after loudest sections.

tempo.feel: Grid-locked four-on-the-floor feel, no swing, no backbeat (ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS). Tempo moves are steps and arches, never smooth ramps (except ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS' finale accelerando ~8 BPM).

timbre.palette_notes: Bright valleys, dark endings: quiet sections run bright (MONASTERY valley ~3449 Hz centroid; GEOMETRY OF BELIEF valley brightest stretch), loud endings run dark (ZERO DAY finale centroid 2706->1287 Hz while RMS peaks; TIMETABLE final window 749 Hz; DIGITAL HOUSE OF CARDS close 618 Hz). Darkness marks structural turns. Brightest track MONASTERY (mean centroid 3412 Hz); darkest DIAGNOSTIC OVERLOAD (1937 Hz); album range 1937-3412 Hz. Sub-bass is the lead instrument (ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS: bass carries melody, sub glides like an 808 line 29-117 Hz, finale 99.6% energy <200 Hz). Near-white digital noise bursts ('digital shrapnel', flatness 0.25-0.38, ZCR up to 0.505) in ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS breakdowns. Limiter pinned at 0 dBFS as an instrument (ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS ~47% of time, TIMETABLE ~half its windows, LYRICAL DOOM nearly every block) - loudness managed, never clips. Near-mono mix measured on ARTIFICIAL INSTRUMENTS (L/R corr 0.85-0.99); stereo width unmeasured on other tracks. Overall RMS range across album: TIMETABLE loudest -6.9 dB, USER & MACHINE quietest -21.6 dB. Dynamic range per track 10.7-28.1 dB (working range).
